intro: Covers the US session of Tuesday 10 November. Delayed from the first attempt; some SPI and calendar items could not be fully verified (see footnotes).
footnotes: Index closes and VIX from Yahoo Finance; Trading Economics CFD quotes differed slightly (S&P 500 7,528.50, -0.32%; Dow 52,282, -0.18%; VIX 19.45). 10-year yield: Trading Economics 4.99%, +10 bp. Spot gold per Trading Economics; gold futures fell 1.84% (Yahoo). AUD/USD, Brent, gold and iron ore are Trading Economics CFD-based reference prices.

setup.summary: SPI 200 futures are indicated at about 9,119 (Dec contract), roughly flat to slightly lower: -0.05% (TradingView) to -0.18% (Investing.com). The quotes carry no timestamp and may not fully reflect the post-US-close move, so treat the figure as approximate. Applying the midpoint (-0.12%) to the prior ASX 200 close of 9,129.0 (+1.10% on Tuesday, a two-month closing high) implies an open about 10 points lower, near 9,118.

local_events: No scheduled Australian releases could be verified (the FNArena calendar is members-only).
what_moved: Wall Street reversed part of Monday's strong rally after October US CPI came in hotter than expected (+0.4% m/m vs 0.3% forecast; core +0.3% vs 0.2%), lifting bets on a December Fed rate hike. The 10-year yield climbed to about 5%, and Nvidia fell around 5% amid reports of a board investigation into its CEO. Sector-level S&P 500 moves were not available from the sources used.

news.headline: Hot CPI raises Fed hike odds.
news.summary: October CPI rose 0.4% m/m and core 0.3%; markets price roughly 80% or more odds of a December hike.

news.headline: Fed officials lean hawkish.
news.summary: Governor Waller reportedly backs a 50 bp December hike if inflation keeps accelerating; Dallas Fed's Logan reportedly backs at least two more 25 bp hikes.

news.headline: 10-year yield tests 5%.
news.summary: The US 10-year moved above 5% intraday before settling near 4.98%.

news.headline: Gold slides.
news.summary: Spot gold fell about 2.7% to around US$4,031/oz on the rate-hike repricing.

news.headline: Oil eases on Iran talk.
news.summary: Brent slipped 0.7% after Trump said further strikes may not be needed and Qatar mediated, though tanker attacks in Hormuz continued.

news.headline: RBA hikes again.
news.summary: The RBA raised rates for a fifth time this year (6-3 vote) and dropped its tightening bias; swaps imply about 80% odds rates have peaked.

news.headline: ASX 200 hits two-month high.
news.summary: The index gained about 1.1% on Tuesday, led by industrials, tech and logistics.

news.headline: Nvidia board probe.
news.summary: Nvidia fell about 5% on reports of a board investigation into its CEO.

coming_up: Thursday 12 November: RBA board member Marnie Baker speaks. Nvidia earnings are due around 17 November.
